title: Read-modify-write review comments under a lock
description: Load comments, apply a mutation, sort, and save, all under a single-process mutex.
signature: pub fn edit<T>(app: &AppHandle, cluster_id: &str, change: impl FnOnce(&mut Vec<ReviewComment>) -> Result<T>) -> Result<T>
semantics: Serializes comment mutations to prevent race conditions, returning the outcome of the change function.
